plan: Given my private value of $12, I aim to bid slightly below this to ensure potential profit if I win. Rational bidders will likely bid near their value. To maximize profit, I should bid lower than my value but high enough to outbid others who might have low values. A bid around $10 optimizes my chance to win without risking overpayment if others have values near mine.

Given my private value of $45, I aim to bid just below my value to maximize potential profit while considering the rational behavior of other bidders. Since values are uniformly distributed between $0 and $49, I expect others to bid close to their values. To balance winning chances and profit, I'll bid slightly below my value, say $43, to ensure a win if others bid closer to their values but not too high to minimize potential loss from the third-highest bid. This strategy optimizes my chance of winning while keeping costs manageable.

Given my value of $5, my goal is to maximize profit by winning the auction at a cost lower than my value. Other bidders, knowing the prize value range, will likely bid close to their values. To avoid overbidding, I should bid conservatively. I will bid slightly above half my value to account for the possibility of them bidding higher. This strategy minimizes risk while maintaining a chance to win.
